summary: Official DRC land-registry custody and formal cadastral-search procedures were evidenced, including the Ministry directory covering Lualaba and Lubudi. No anonymous Fungurume parcel ID plus geometry response, public viewer/API, schema, CRS, or citywide open coverage was verified. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French discovery queries are recorded in city-6055-fungurume.json. They found official Ministry of Land Affairs and public-service procedure pages but no Fungurume-specific open parcel service.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified anonymous GETs fetched the official Ministry circonscriptions directory, official public-service registry procedure, and BIC landing page. A bounded public ArcGIS search for Fungurume parcel items returned zero results. No credentials, login, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe property lookup, formal submission, or TLS disablement was used.
scopeLimits: The WUP point [-10.6190040878108, 26.3302679663275] was preserved exactly in latitude/longitude order.
No exact-point hit or miss, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was treated as evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
Ministry registry custody and formal search procedures do not prove public vector geometry availability or Fungurume coverage.
The Ministry directory lists Lualaba and Lubudi circonscriptions, but the fetched public page exposed no parcel layer or Fungurume endpoint.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel geometry and stable identity response was obtained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
